r5_attribution.basis: analytic; date correction first with endpoint policy held fixed

ranking.legacy_behavior: Each segment is labelled with its end point's UTC date.
ranking.title: Distance is dated by UTC calendar day, not the UTC+9 report day

ranking.legacy_behavior: No speed filter; the spike's out-and-back chords are both counted.
ranking.title: Speed spikes above 150 km/h are billed

ranking.legacy_behavior: No dedupe; a late or conflicting copy becomes a new segment end.
ranking.title: Duplicate pings (same driver and timestamp) are counted again

ranking.legacy_behavior: No road filter; the detour to the noisy ping is counted.
ranking.title: Pings more than 100 m off the road are billed

ranking.legacy_behavior: Entry segment counted whole; exit segment dropped whole.
ranking.title: Zone membership decided by segment end point only

ranking.legacy_behavior: An out-of-order row creates a backward segment.
ranking.title: Late pings are joined in file order, not by their own timestamp
